definitions: A privately owned individual unit within a multi-unit building, typically an apartment building, combined with shared ownership of common areas and facilities, and designated for use as a residence.
A form of real estate ownership where individuals own a specific living space and jointly own common areas and amenities within a larger complex, intended for residential purposes.
examples: She purchased a residential condominium in the city center.
The new development features several residential condominiums with river views.
Maintenance fees for a residential condominium often cover shared amenities.
